snippet.title: JUMANJI: OPEN WORLD - New Trailer (4K)
snippet.description:
Our world. New rules. One final game.

The final countdown begins. Watch the new trailer for #Jumanji: Open World - exclusively in theatres Christmas Day.

Follow Us On Social:
https://www.facebook.com/JumanjiMovie
https://www.twitter.com/JumanjiMovie
https://www.instagram.com/JumanjiMovie
https://www.tiktok.com/@jumanjimovie

This Christmas, Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black, and Karen Gillan are reunited in Jumanji: Open World, the hilarious final installment of the globally beloved action-adventure trilogy. Our heroes have escaped the perilous jungles of Jumanji before, but this time Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world. 

Directed by:                                   Jake Kasdan    
Written by:                                     Jake Kasdan & Jeff Pinkner & Scott Rosenberg 

Based on the book Jumanji by: Chris Van Allsburg 

Produced by:                                Matt Tolmach 
                                                       Jake Kasdan 
                                                       Dwayne Johnson 
                                                       Dany Garcia 
                                                       Hiram Garcia 

 Executive Producers:                Barry Waldman 
                                                      Melvin Mar 
                                                      William Teitler 
                                                      Ted Field 
                                                      Mike Weber 
                                                      Chris Van Allsburg 
                                                      Jeff Pinkner 
                                                      Scott Rosenberg

snippet.title: Dune: Part Three | Final Trailer
snippet.description:
Do not fear the end. Dune: Part Three only in theaters and IMAX December 18. Tickets on sale now around the world. http://fandan.co/DunePartThree #DuneMovie #FilmedForIMAX 

From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion.

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

The film stars Oscar nominee Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Oscar nominee Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach de Bankolé, with Oscar nominee Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Oscar winner Javier Bardem.

Villeneuve directs from a screenplay by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novels written by Frank Herbert. The film is produced by Oscar nominees Mary Parent, Cale Boyter, Villeneuve and Tanya Lapointe, and Joe Caracciolo, and executive produced by Joshua Grode, Thomas Tull, Herbert W. Gains, Brian Herbert, Byron Merritt, Kim Herbert, Kevin J. Anderson, Richard P. Rubinstein, John Harrison and Jessica Derhammer.

Joining Villeneuve behind the camera are Oscar-winning director of photography Linus Sandgren, Oscar-winning production designer Patrice Vermette, Oscar-winning editor Joe Walker, Oscar nominated costume designer Jacqueline West, Oscar-nominated casting director Francine Maisler, and Oscar-winning composer Hans Zimmer.

Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures Present A Legendary Pictures Production, A Film By Denis Villeneuve, Dune: Part Three, only in theaters and IMAX® across North America on December 18, 2026 and internationally beginning 16 December 2026. The film will be distributed worldwide by Warner Bros. Pictures and in China by Legendary East.

Song: Aaj Se Teri
Singer: Arijit Singh
Music: Amit Trivedi
Lyricist: Kausar Munir

Recording Engineers A T Studios  Mumbai  - Abhishek Sortey & Urmila Sutar

Shehnai - Omkar Dhumal

Cast - Akshay Kumar, Radhika Apte & Sonam Kapoor
Production House - Hope Production Pvt Ltd
Producer - Twinkle Khanna, SPE Films India, KriArj Entertainment, Cape Of Good Films & Hope Productions
Director - R Balki

Aaj Se Teri Saari Galiyaan Meri Ho Gayi, 
Aaj Se Mera Ghar Tera Ho Gaya…

Aaj Se Mera Ghar Tera Ho Gaya…
Aaj Se Meri Saari Khushiyaan Teri Ho Gayi,
Aaj Se Tera Gum Mera Ho Gaya. 

Ho Tere Kandhe Ka Jo Til Hai, 
Ho Tera Seene Mein Jo Dil Hai, 
Ho Teri Bijli Ka Jo Bill Hai-
Aaj Se Mera Ho Gaya…

Ho Mere Khwabon Ka Ambar,
Ho Meri Khushiyon Ka Samandar,
Ho Mere Pin Code Ka Number-
Aaj Se Tera Ho Gaya. 

Antara 1- 
Tere Maathe Aaaaa….Tere Maathe Ke Kumkum Ko
Main Tilak Lagaa Ke Ghoomoonga, 
Teri Baali Ki Chhunchhun Ko
Main Dil Se Lagaa Ke Jhoomoonga…

Meri Chhoti Si Bhoolon, 
Ko Tu Nadiya Mein Baha Dena.
Tere Jude Ke Phoolon Ko, 
Main Apne Shirt Mein Pehnoonga.

Bas Mere Liye Tu Maalpue Kabhi Kabhi Bana Dena…

Aaj Se Meri Saari Ratiyaan Teri Ho Gayi, 
Aaj Se Tera Din Mera Ho Gaya. 

Ho Tere Kandhe Ka Jo Til Hai, 
Ho Tera Seene Mein Jo Dil Hai, 
Ho Teri Bijli Ka Jo Bill Hai-
Aaj Se Mera Ho Gaya…

Ho Mere Pin Code Ka Number-
Aaj Se Tera Ho Gaya.

Tu Maange Sardi Mein Amiya, 
Jo Maange Garmi Mein Mungphaliyaan, 
Tu Baarish Mein Agar Keh De,
Ja Mere Liye Tu Dhoop Khila.

Toh Main Saawan Ko Gatak Loonga,
Toh Saare Taaron Sang Chanda
Main Teri Goad Mein Rakh Doonga-

Bas Mere Liye Tu Khil Ke Kabhi Muskuraa Dena…

Aaj Se Meri Saari Sadiyaan Teri Ho Gayi, 
Aaj Se Tera Pal Mera Ho Gaya. 

Ho Tere Kandhe Ka Jo Til Hai, 
Ho Tere Seene Mein Jo Dil Hai, 
Ho Teri Bijli Ka Jo Bill Hai-
Aaj Se Mera Ho Gaya…

Aaj Se ……Tera Ho Gaya.

snippet.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend - New Trailer - Only In Cinemas November 5
snippet.description:
RAMAYANA: RISE OF A LEGEND - only in cinemas, IMAX and Premium Large Formats worldwide November 5. Tickets on Sale now.

Based on the celebrated ancient epic known to billions, Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend tells the story of Rama, a prince bound by sacrifice; Ravana, an immortal king driven by vengeance; and the prophecy that binds their fates together. It stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi. 

The film is produced by acclaimed filmmaker Namit Malhotra, whose Academy Award®-winning visual effects company DNEG has worked on films including The Odyssey, Dune, Interstellar, and Inception; directed by Nitesh Tiwari, whose film Dangal remains the highest-grossing Indian film worldwide; and scored by Academy Award® winners Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman. Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend will be released globally in cinemas in time for Diwali on November 5.

Follow us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/sonypicturesuk
Find us on Instagram at http://www.instagram.com/sonypicturesuk 
Follow us on Twitter at https://twitter.com/sonypicturesuk 
Find us on TikTok at https://www.tiktok.com/@sonypictures.uk

Produced by: Namit Malhotra
Directed by: Nitesh Tiwari
Starring: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi
Music: Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman
Adaptation by: Shridhar Raghavan, Nitesh Tiwari
Editing by: Huzefa Lokhandwala
Production Design by: Ravi Bansal, Ramsey Avery
Action Design by: Guy Norris, Terry Notary
Costume Design by: Rimple & Harpreet Narula and Saniya Sardhariya
Visual Effects by: Dan Glass

In an age of gods and kings, the fate of worlds hangs in the balance. Rama, a prince bound by duty, sacrifice, and righteousness, must confront Ravana, an immortal ruler driven by pride and vengeance, powerful enough to shatter the cosmos.

snippet.title: GODZILLA MINUS ZERO | Official  Trailer | In Theaters This November
snippet.description:
Everything ends here. Experience GODZILLA MINUS ZERO, the first-ever Japanese production #FilmedForIMAX, in theatres across India this November.

GODZILLA MINUS ZERO
VFX, Written, and Directed by Takashi Yamazaki
In theatres this November | IMAX, premium formats and every screen
Brought to India by PVR INOX Pictures

War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.

There is no third time. Everything ends here.

Shot entirely in Japan as the first-ever Japanese production to be Filmed For IMAX, GODZILLA MINUS ZERO was shot with high-definition digital cameras certified by IMAX, and optimized in sound and imagery unique to IMAX screens. The globally beloved monster returns to movie theater screens reaching greater and more terrifying heights, making GODZILLA MINUS ZERO a true cinematic event not to be missed.

Presenting the first single, “Ruku Ruku Rukmini,” from Alias Rukmini starring Nithiin,  Aafiya Sayed, and others. Directed by Murali Kanth, with music composed by Vijai Bulganin.

Audio on Saregama

Lyrics:
Pallavi

Thakadimi thaana ani aadukoke bangaaram
Thikamaka chesi alaa vellipoke bangaaram
Anumathi ivvamani vedukona bangaaram
Bahumathi laaga ninnu choosukunta bangaaram

Gundellona pettesaavu chitti alarm
Nuvvegaani dhakkaavante dhummu dhumaaram
Yes annaavo No annavo yenti viddooram
Thallakindhaipoyindhamma naadhi yavvaaram

Rathri pagalu
Okate dhigulu
Ivvavaa badhulu

O…! Nee raakatho naa life ke sarikotta modhalu

Rukku Rukku Rukmini oppesuko maa raani
Kittu kittu Kittayyaki nuvvene aliveni × 2

Charanam

Thatti lepaavule chitti gunde idhi
Thattukolenule ee haayi

Ottugaa cheppanaa
Oppukuntavani nammakam unnadhe… Ammayi

Ninne naathoni vadhilesi
Yetugaa vellaave ososi
Nidhraahaaralu maanesi…
Needhe aalochanaa!

Enno kalalu
Yerupe kanulu
Kaavem panulu…

O… Nee raakatho naa life ke sarikotta modhalu

Rukku Rukku Rukmini oppesuko maa raani
Kittu kittu Kittayyaki nuvvene aliveni × 2

Pallavi (Repeat)

Thakadimi thaana ani aadukoke bangaaram
Thikamaka chesi alaa vellipoke bangaaram
Anumathi ivvamani vedukona bangaaram
Bahumathi laaga ninnu choosukunta bangaaram

Gundellona pettesaavu chitti alarm
Nuvvegaani dhakkaavante dhummu dhumaaram
Yes annaavo No annavo yenti viddooram
Thallakindhaipoyindhamma naadhi yavvaaram

Rukku Rukku Rukmini oppesuko maa raani
Kittu kittu Kittayyaki nuvvene aliveni × 2

snippet.title: Karwa Chauth Hindi Song 2026 | Sangini Music #karwachauthsong
snippet.description:
#karwachauth #karwachauthsong #karvachauth #sanginimusic
“Jug Jug Jiyo Re Piya” (जुग-जुग जियो रे पिया) is a romantic Karwa Chauth song blending Hindi lyrics, a Bihari/Bhojpuri folk touch and two contrasting female voices. Celebrate Karwa Chauth 2026 with a wife’s heartfelt blessing for her beloved.

Celebrate the sacred bond of Karwa Chauth with this soulful Karwa Chauth song, perfect for your festive family gatherings.

This video captures the essence of the occasion, showcasing traditional customs and the spirit of togetherness that defines this special day. Whether you are preparing for the evening ceremonies or gathering with loved ones, this track provides the perfect musical backdrop to honor your customs and observe your Karwa Chauth rituals.

Our new festive Hindi song features authentic melodies and heartfelt lyrics that reflect the joy and devotion shared during this occasion. It is designed to accompany your celebrations, bringing a sense of peace and cultural connection as families come together to observe age-old traditions through traditional Indian music. This performance highlights the beauty of an Indian festival celebration, capturing the serene and devotional atmosphere of the night.

🌙 KARWA CHAUTH: HISTORY, TRADITIONS & SIGNIFICANCE

Karwa Chauth, also written Karva Chauth and known as Karaka Chaturthi, is a long-standing Hindu observance associated especially with North India. It falls on Kartik Krishna Chaturthi in the North Indian calendar. “Karwa” refers to a small earthen pitcher, and “Chauth” to the fourth lunar day. Its heritage is preserved in regional customs and devotional legends, including the story of Veeravati, shared through Karwa Chauth vrat katha.

Traditionally, married women fast from sunrise until moonrise, often without food or water, and pray for their husbands’ well-being. Customs include the pre-dawn sargi meal in some communities, mehendi, bridal adornment, Maa Gauri or Parvati puja, and gatherings for the vrat katha. At moonrise, many offer water to the moon, view it and their husband through a sieve, and break the fast with their husband’s help.

Celebrated particularly in Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Delhi, the festival brings together prayers for marital well-being, family bonds and enduring love. Customs vary across families and regions.

🎶 THE MUSIC

An earthy Bihari/Bhojpuri-style female folk voice answers a soft Hindi female lead through repeated blessings, call-and-response and a shared refrain. Dholak, tabla and manjira bring an eight-beat keherwa groove, with harmonium, bansuri and shehnai colours, acoustic guitar, warm bass and atmospheric synth textures. Indian folk warmth meets contemporary fusion in this festive love song.

❤️ LINES FROM THE SONG

जुग-जुग जियो रे पिया,
जनम-जनम के मीत हो पिया,
तोहसे लागे प्रीत हो पिया।

मैया गौरी से माँगा है मैंने,
लंबी उमर का वरदान मिले।
सदा सुहागन रहूँ हमेशा
खुशियों से परिवार खिले।

सात जनम भी कम पड़ जाएँ,
हर जनम लिख दूँ तेरे नाम।

🎧 Listen with headphones or a good music system to enjoy the contrasting voices, layered harmonies and folk instruments.

यह करवा चौथ गीत हर उस प्रेम और प्रार्थना को समर्पित है, जिसमें अपने जीवनसाथी की खुशियाँ ही सबसे अनमोल उपहार होती हैं।

“Jug Jug Jiyo Re Piya” (जुग-जुग जियो रे पिया) is a romantic Karwa Chauth song blending Hindi lyrics, a Bihari/Bhojpuri folk touch and two contrasting female voices. Celebrate Karwa Chauth 2026 with a wife’s heartfelt blessing for her beloved.

Celebrate the sacred bond of Karwa Chauth with this soulful Karwa Chauth song, perfect for your festive family gatherings.

This video captures the essence of the occasion, showcasing traditional customs and the spirit of togetherness that defines this special day. Whether you are preparing for the evening ceremonies or gathering with loved ones, this track provides the perfect musical backdrop to honor your customs and observe your Karwa Chauth rituals.

Our new festive Hindi song features authentic melodies and heartfelt lyrics that reflect the joy and devotion shared during this occasion. It is designed to accompany your celebrations, bringing a sense of peace and cultural connection as families come together to observe age-old traditions through traditional Indian music. This performance highlights the beauty of an Indian festival celebration, capturing the serene and devotional atmosphere of the night.

🌙 KARWA CHAUTH: HISTORY, TRADITIONS & SIGNIFICANCE

Karwa Chauth, also written Karva Chauth and known as Karaka Chaturthi, is a long-standing Hindu observance associated especially with North India. It falls on Kartik Krishna Chaturthi in the North Indian calendar. “Karwa” refers to a small earthen pitcher, and “Chauth” to the fourth lunar day. Its heritage is preserved in regional customs and devotional legends, including the story of Veeravati, shared through Karwa Chauth vrat katha.

Traditionally, married women fast from sunrise until moonrise, often without food or water, and pray for their husbands’ well-being. Customs include the pre-dawn sargi meal in some communities, mehendi, bridal adornment, Maa Gauri or Parvati puja, and gatherings for the vrat katha. At moonrise, many offer water to the moon, view it and their husband through a sieve, and break the fast with their husband’s help.

Celebrated particularly in Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Delhi, the festival brings together prayers for marital well-being, family bonds and enduring love. Customs vary across families and regions.

🎶 THE MUSIC

An earthy Bihari/Bhojpuri-style female folk voice answers a soft Hindi female lead through repeated blessings, call-and-response and a shared refrain. Dholak, tabla and manjira bring an eight-beat keherwa groove, with harmonium, bansuri and shehnai colours, acoustic guitar, warm bass and atmospheric synth textures. Indian folk warmth meets contemporary fusion in this festive love song.

जनम-जनम के मीत हो पिया,
तोहसे लागे प्रीत हो पिया।

मैया गौरी से माँगा है मैंने,
लंबी उमर का वरदान मिले।
सदा सुहागन रहूँ हमेशा
खुशियों से परिवार खिले।

सात जनम भी कम पड़ जाएँ,
हर जनम लिख दूँ तेरे नाम।

snippet.title: Zaalima - Lyrical | Raees | Shah Rukh Khan | Arijit Singh & Harshdeep K | JAM8-Pritam
snippet.description:
Song - Zaalima
Music - JAM8
Lyrics - Amitabh Bhattacharya
Singers - Arijit Singh and Harshdeep Kaur
Choreography - Bosco- Caesar

Written by - Rahul Dholakia, Harit Mehta, Ashish Vashi & Niraj Shukla
Director Of Photography - K.U Mohanan ISC
Produced By - Ritesh Sidhwani, Gauri Khan & Farhan Akhtar
Directed By - Rahul Dholakia

Sound Design:- Dj Phukan, Sunny M.R.
Programmers:- Sourav Roy, Dj Phukan, Sunny M.R., Rohan Chauhan, Arijit Singh

Shoot Mix:- Ashwin Kulkarni

Lyrics:
Jo Teri Khatir Tadpe Pehle Se Hi
Kya Usey Tadpana O Zaalima, O Zaalima
Jo Tere Ishq Mein Behka Pehle Se Hi
Kya Usey Behkana O Zaalima, O Zaalima

Aankhen Marhaba, Baatein Marhaba
Main Sau Martaba Deewana Huaa
Mera Na Raha Jab Se Dil Mera
Tere Husn Ka Nishana Hua

Jiski Har Dhadkan Tu Ho
Aise Dil Ko Kya Dhadkana
O Zaalima, O Zaalima

Saanson Mein Teri Nazdeeqiyon Ka
Itrr Tu Ghol De, Ghol De…
Main Hi Kyun Ishq Zaahir Karun
Tu Bhi Kabhi Bol De, Bol De…

Leke Jaan Hi Jaayega Meri
Qaatil Har Tera Bahaana Hua
Tujhse Hi Shuru
Tujhpe Hi Khatam
Mere Pyaar Ka Fasaana Hua

Tu Shamma Hai Toh Yaad Rakhna
Main Bhi Hoon Parwaana
O Zaalima, O Zaalima..

Deedaar Tera Milne Ke Baad Hi
Chhoote Meri Angdaayi
Tu Hi Bata De Kyun Zaalima Main Kehlayi..

snippet.title: Yeh Galiyan Yeh Chaubara | 8K Video Song | Padmini Kolhapure | Emotional विदाई गीत
snippet.description:
Song: Yeh Galiyan Yeh Chaubara
Singer: Lata Mangeshkar
Movie: Prem Rog (1982)
Starring: Rishi Kapoor, Padmini Kolhapure
Music By: Laxmikant–Pyarelal
Lyrics: Santosh Anand


Lyrics:

ye galiya ye chaubaara yaha aana na dobaara
ye galiya ye chaubaara yaha aana na dobaara
ab ham to bhaye pardesi ke tera yaha koi nahi
ke tera yaha koi nahi
le jaa rang-birangi yade hasne rone ki buniyade
ab ham to bhaye pardesi ke tera yaha koi nahi
ke tera yaha koi nahi

mere haatho me bhari-bhari chudiya
mujhe bha gayi hari-hari chudiya
dekh milati hai teri-meri chudiya
tere jaisi saheli meri chudiya
tune pisi vo mehandi rang layi
mori gori hatheli rachaayi
teri aankh kyo laado bhar aayi
tere ghar bhi bajegi shahnayi
saavan me baadal se kehna pardes me hai teri behna
ab ham to bhaye pardesi ke tera yaha koi nahi
ke tera yaha koi nahi

aa ma milne ai mil le gale chale ham sasural chale
tere aangan me apna bas bachpan chhod chale
kal bhi suraj nikalega kal bhi panchhi gaayenge
sab tujhko dikhaayi denge par ham na nazar aayenge
aanchal me sanjo lena hamko sapno me bula lena hamko
ab ham to bhaye pardesi ke tera yaha koi nahi
ke tera yaha koi nahi

dekh tu na hame bhulana maana dur hame hai jaana
meri alhad si atkheliya sada palko me basaana
jab bajne lage baaje-gaaje jag lagne lage khaali-khaali
us dam tu itna samajhna meri doli uthi hai phulo vaali
thode din ye nate the kabhi haste the gaate the
ab ham to bhaye pardesi ke tera yaha koi nahi
ke tera yaha koi nahi
ye galiya ye chaubaara yaha aana na dobaara
ab ham to bhaye pardesi ke tera yaha koi nahi
ke tera yaha koi nah

🎶 @SaregamaHumBhojpuri presents "Palang Ke Turi", a new Bhojpuri video song featuring the energetic voice of Arvind Akela Kallu and the screen presence of Mahi Shrivastava.

Credits:

Album Title: Palang Ke Turi
Song Title: Palang Ke Turi
Singer: Arvind Akela Kallu, Shilpi Raj
Lyricist: Gautam Rai Kala Nag
Music Director: Priyanshu Singh
Featuring: Mahi Shrivastava
Director & Choreographer: Raunak Raut
Assistant Choreographer: Vivek Mandal
DOP: Vazeer Art & Rahul Yadav
Editor: Rohan
DI: Sandeep Bajpai
BTS: Rahul Sharma
Makeup: Shibu
Art: Pawan

Lyrics:

M - घटतावे वेट , हई जवानी चकलेट तोहार सुना हुआ है 
हाल बा बेहाल , जान बीतल कई साल नाही मुना हुआ है 
F - के देखी सजल सिंगरवा कवन छुई बदन अंगूरी 
आय हाय रे मजबूरी , पिया बिना पलंग के तुरी 
अरे खनकेला कंगना चूरी 
पिया बिना पलंग के तुरी 

F - जवानी देता दरद हो , विदेश बाटे मरद हो 
M - रूपईया ला मुहवा मोडले बा , जवानी करोड़ो के छोड़ले बा
F - रहे सपनावा की सटीत सजानवा 
गाना बजाके भोजपुरी 
आय हाय रे मजबूरी , पिया बिना पलंग के तुरी 
अरे खनकेला कंगना चूरी 
पिया बिना पलंग के तुरी 

F - मन के मनाई कईसे, सजन के बोलाई कईसे
M - नज़र में केहू त धसल बा, लगाताटे दोसरे से फसल बा 
F - पता चली त ओकरा सीधे मारब करेजा में गोली
आय हाय रे मजबूरी , पिया बिना पलंग के तुरी 
अरे खनकेला कंगना चूरी 
पिया बिना पलंग के तुरी

snippet.description:
Kannukkulle Unnai Vaithen Song | Pennin Manathai Thottu (2000) | P. Unnikrishnan | S. A. Rajkumar

Song Description

Enjoy “Kannukkulle Unnai Vaithen” (கண்ணுக்குள்ளே உன்னை வைத்தேன்), a beautiful and soulful romantic melody from the Tamil film Pennin Manathai Thottu (2000), starring Prabhu Deva and Jaya Seal.

Featuring the melodious voice of P. Unnikrishnan, this song expresses deep love, affection, and the desire to keep a beloved person close to the heart forever. Its romantic imagery describes a love so precious that the singer wishes to cherish the beloved every moment, never letting distance or separation weaken their bond.

Composed by S. A. Rajkumar, the song blends a soothing melody with heartfelt vocals and memorable lyrics. The official music-video credits list Vaali and Vairamuthu as lyricists.

The Meaning and Emotion of the Song

The song conveys the feeling of being completely captivated by someone special. The beloved becomes a source of happiness, comfort, and emotional fulfilment. The lyrics use the image of keeping someone within one's eyes as a poetic expression of constant love and devotion.

P. Unnikrishnan's expressive singing gives the melody a gentle, intimate quality, making it suitable for romantic playlists, love-themed videos, and listeners who enjoy Tamil film melodies from the late 1990s and early 2000s.

Musical Highlights

Singer: P. Unnikrishnan's smooth, expressive vocals.
Composer: S. A. Rajkumar's memorable romantic melody.
Lyrics: Official video credits list Vaali and Vairamuthu.
Mood: Romantic, soothing, emotional, and nostalgic.
Film: A memorable musical selection from Pennin Manathai Thottu.

About Pennin Manathai Thottu

Pennin Manathai Thottu is a Tamil romantic drama released in 2000. Directed by Ezhil, the film stars Prabhu Deva and Jaya Seal, with R. Sarathkumar appearing in an extended guest role.

The film follows a heart surgeon whose life becomes emotionally complicated when a woman from his past enters his professional world. The story explores love, personal relationships, misunderstandings, and emotional conflict.

The soundtrack, composed by S. A. Rajkumar, features a variety of melodies and lively songs. “Kannukkulle Unnai Vaithen” is one of its romantic selections, expressing the tenderness and intensity of love through a soothing musical arrangement.

snippet.title: मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधा | Mohe Mor Banaiyo Radha Apne Vrindavan Ko | Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan
snippet.description:
मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधा | Mohe Mor Banaiyo Radha Apne Vrindavan Ko | Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan


 #radhabhajan #krishnabhajan #radharani
#radhakrishna #radhabhajan #krishnabhajan
मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधा | Mohe Mor Banaiyo Radha Apne Vrindavan Ko | Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan


मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधा - वृंदावन की इस पावन धुन में खो जाएँ। Bajao Bhakti आपके लिए लेकर आया है श्री राधा-कृष्ण की महिमा का एक ऐसा भजन जो आपके हृदय को शांति और आनंद से भर देगा।

यह मधुर और भावपूर्ण Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan ब्रज की पावन भावना और राधा-कृष्ण के दिव्य प्रेम को समर्पित है।
“मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधाअपने वृंदावन को” – यह पंक्ति भक्त की उस विनम्र प्रार्थना को दर्शाती है, जहाँ वह ब्रजधाम में मोर बनकर भी राधा-कृष्ण के चरणों में रहना चाहता है।

यह भजन ध्यान, जप, सुबह-शाम की पूजा, वृंदावन भक्ति, कीर्तन और मन की शांति के लिए अत्यंत उपयुक्त है। इसकी शांत धुन और प्रेमपूर्ण शब्द आत्मा को सुकून देते हैं और मन को वृंदावन की गलियों में ले जाते हैं।



Soulful Peace: Perfect for morning meditation or evening relaxation.

📌 Keywords: Mohe Mor Banaiyo To Banaiyo Vrindavan Ko, मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधा, Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan, Vrindavan Bhajan, Radha Krishna Song 2026, Bunty Thakur Bhajan, Krishna Meditation Music, Radha Rani Bhajan, Braj Bhakti Song

#radhakrishna #radhabhajan #krishnabhajan #radharani


राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा

मुखड़ा

मोहे मोर बनइयो राधा अपने वृंदावन को मैं नाच-नाच कूद के तुमको रिझाऊंगी। मोहे बंद बनइयो तो बनइयो सेवा कुंज को मैं कूक-फांद ब्रज में जोर दिखाऊंगी। मैं कूक-फांद ब्रज में जोर दिखाऊंगी।

मोहे भिख बनइयो तो बनइयो गोवर्धन को मैं मांग-मांग कूद के ब्रजवासियों के खाऊंगी। मोहे रसिक बनइयो तो बनइयो बरसाने को मैं आठों याम राधा राधा नाम गाऊंगी। मैं आठों याम राधा राधा नाम गाऊंगी।

राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा

अंतरा 1

मोहे तिलक बनइयो राधा अपने मस्तक को मैं तीनों लोकों के सर का ताज बन जाऊंगी। मोहे कंठ बनइयो राधा अपने गले को मैं मीठी-मीठी बोल जग अपने बनाऊंगी। मैं मीठी-मीठी बोल जग अपने बनाऊंगी।

मोहे कंगन बनइयो राधा अपने हाथन को मैं दुनिया में सबसे अनमोल कहलाऊंगी। मोहे पायल बनइयो राधा अपने पैरों की मैं छम-छम कर सारी ब्रज घूम आऊंगी। मैं छम-छम कर सारी ब्रज घूम आऊंगी।

राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा

अंतरा 2

मोहे लता बनइयो राधा अपने निववन की मैं झूम-झूम कृष्ण राधा रास देख पाऊंगी। मोहे जल बनइयो तो बनइयो जमुना जी को मैं ब्रज भूमि में अमृत छलकाऊंगी। मैं ब्रज भूमि में अमृत छलकाऊंगी।

मोहे पेड़ बनइयो तो बनइयो कदम को मैं कान्हा के संग मिल तीर पर झूलाऊंगी। मोहे कदंब बनइयो तो बनइयो नंदगांव को मैं गोपियों की मटकी फोड़ माखन गिराऊंगी। मैं गोपियों की मटकी फोड़ माखन गिराऊंगी।

राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा

अंतरा 3

मोहे कोयल बनइयो राधा अपने बाग को मैं दुनिया को मीठी मीठी राग सुनाऊंगी। मोहे फूल बनइयो राधा अपनी माला को मैं राधा राधा बोल सारे जग महकाऊंगी। मैं राधा राधा बोल सारे जग महकाऊंगी।

मोहे संत बनइयो तो बनइयो प्रेमदास मैं अपना जीवन राधा नाम पे लुटाऊंगी। मोहे दासी बनइयो राधा अपने चरणों की मैं राधा नाम के भजन गाऊंगी। मैं राधा नाम के भजन गाऊंगी।

राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा राधा

समापन

मोहे मोर बनइयो राधा अपने वृंदावन को मैं नाच-नाच कूद के तुमको रिझाऊंगी। मोहे बंद बनइयो तो बनइयो सेवा कुंज को मैं कूक-फांद ब्रज में जोर दिखाऊंगी। मैं कूक-फांद ब्रज में जोर दिखाऊंगी।
